## EMPIRICAL THERAPY FOR OSTEOMYELITIS

## Recommend Infectious Disease consultation.

Bone culture is essential and diagnostic. If patient is not clinically ill and a
diagnostic procedure is planned, antibiotics can be held until after the
procedure.

Therapy should be modified when culture results and patient response to therapy
are known.

Duration of treatment is 4 to 6 weeks.

## Empiric Therapy

Preferred:

Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h M
History of Pseudomonas in wound:

Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 gm IV q6h R
If MRSA history:

<ADD> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h R

## Oral switch recommendations based on culture results

Treatment for MSSA and streptococci:

Cefadroxil 1000 mg PO q12h R
Treatment for MRSA:

Doxycycline 100 mg PO q12h DI
< OR >
Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet PO q12h R,DI
